Physiotherapist - Musculoskeletal and Sports

PROFILE
Physiotherapist with seven years in private musculoskeletal and sports practice. AHPRA registered (general). I treat a busy caseload of sports injuries, post-surgical rehab and persistent pain, and I run the clinic's Pilates program. Looking for senior physiotherapist or musculoskeletal physiotherapist roles.
